notes:
{冬|ふゆ} is the season of winter, typically from December to February in Japan.

SEASONS IN JAPANESE:
- {春|はる}: spring
- {夏|なつ}: summer
- {秋|あき}: autumn/fall
- {冬|ふゆ}: winter

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter vacation
- {冬至|とうじ}: winter solstice
- {真冬|まふゆ}: midwinter
- {冬服|ふゆふく}: winter clothing
- {冬物|ふゆもの}: winter goods/items

CULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS:
{冬|ふゆ} is associated with ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year), ⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧ (skiing), ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot springs), and warm foods like ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冬|ふゆ}になる: winter comes, to become winter
- {冬|ふゆ}に: in winter
